description: After uploading a file to the presigned upload_url (or all same-format shards to upload_urls) returned by create_segment(subtype=matched), call this to run LLM-assisted column mapping inference. For a sharded upload, analysis runs against the first shard only — every shard is assumed to share the same schema; a mismatch fails the batch job later with a specific error, not silently here. Returns: segment_id, analysis.columns[] (each: source_column, mapped_to, inferred_type, confidence 0–1, warning), analysis.unmapped_columns[] (column headers that could not be mapped), analysis.recommendations[] (human-readable tips to improve match rates). gzip is detected from file bytes, so a missing or incorrect compression declaration is self-healed during analysis. Returns typed 422 errors for malformed gzip, format mismatch, or malformed input, and 409 FILE_NOT_YET_UPLOADED before upload. The upload is staged (create_segment sets hitl:true) — nothing has started yet. Present these results to the user and wait for their response, then call confirm_column_mappings (to start resolution) or cancel_matched_upload (to abort) — do not call wait_for_segment before confirm_column_mappings succeeds. Requires 'discovery' scope.
